_how_to_use: After adding the ORIGINAL paper photo/scan (jpg/png) to this folder, copy this file to transcription.json and fill the values exactly as written on the paper. The app then compares them with the dashboard and shows AGREES / DOES NOT AGREE. Do not fill values that are not on the paper. If any value differs from the dashboard, explain why in mismatch_explanation (arithmetic slip, tie order, rounding).
